contract: A dedicated MySQL session confirms STRICT_TRANS_TABLES, NO_ZERO_DATE and NO_ZERO_IN_DATE are active.
The server refuses zero and incomplete DATE values with SQLSTATE 22007.
Both refusals leave no rows; a valid DATE persists as the exact native date and text.
The existing permissive-mode zero/partial-date read contract remains covered in the same MySQL value-contract run.

focused_case.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --test integration value_contracts::strict_zero_date_modes_refuse_invalid_dates_without_writing -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

value_contract_group.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --test integration value_contracts:: -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: This case proves MySQL 8 behavior; MariaDB strict zero-date parity is untested.
Other SQL modes, temporal types, consumer paths and installed grid editing remain open.
The broader B3 matrix remains open.
